name: Rigging Evidence
author: PolyKit
description: Checks declarative attachment relationships before rigging and export.

zh-CN.name: 绑定证据
zh-CN.description: 在绑定和导出前检查附件与组件/骨骼的声明关系。

en-US.name: Rigging Evidence
en-US.description: Checks declarative attachment relationships before rigging and export.

nodes.name: Attachment Anchor Audit
nodes.description: Validates attachment anchors, root parenting, cycles, and optional measured proximity.

nodes.name: Rig Payload Audit
nodes.description: Validates portable skeleton hierarchy, coordinate system, local matrices, and four-influence skin weights before export.

nodes.name: Chirality Audit
nodes.description: Checks left/right landmarks for a true sagittal reflection and reports whole-figure symmetry drift.

nodes.name: Geodesic Skin Bind
nodes.description: Generates normalized four-slot skin weights by propagating bone distance through the mesh solid instead of across air gaps.

params_schema.label: Voxel Resolution
params_schema.tooltip: Largest axis voxel resolution used for the solid distance field.

params_schema.label: Falloff Power
params_schema.tooltip: Higher values keep influence tighter around each bone.

nodes.name: Facial Rig Audit
nodes.description: Checks blendshape names, normalized ranges, and optional ARKit-lite channels before facial animation export.

params_schema.label: Shape Profile
params_schema.tooltip: Required shape profile; custom uses payload.requiredShapes when supplied.

params_schema.label: Require Visemes
params_schema.tooltip: Also require a complete portable lip-sync viseme map.

nodes.name: Lip-sync Audit
nodes.description: Validates a portable viseme map and optional time-sampled mouth curves without claiming speech recognition quality.

nodes.name: Expression Clip Compiler
nodes.description: Compiles named blendshape expression clips into dense, normalized keyframes and per-shape channels.

nodes.name: FABRIK IK Solve
nodes.description: Solves an explicitly ordered joint chain toward a target with CPU FABRIK and reports convergence or reach limits.

params_schema.label: Tolerance
params_schema.tooltip: Target distance at which the chain is considered converged.

nodes.name: Mixamo Compatibility Audit
nodes.description: Checks canonical Mixamo body names, aliases, parent chains, and cycles before retargeting an animation clip.

params_schema.label: Require Fingers
params_schema.tooltip: Require the first phalanx of each hand for finger animation retargeting.
